members.model_name: Inelastic dark matter with a dark photon mediator
members.description: The FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the two-state Majorana inelastic dark matter with kinetically mixed dark photon is not confirmed public, blocking off-the-shelf reproduction of the micrOMEGAs coannihilation thermal targets over (m_chi1, Delta, m_A', epsilon, alpha_D).
members.proposed_resolution: Release or re-derive the FeynRules v2.3.32 iDM implementation, export CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs v5.0.6, and validate against the paper's benchmark thermal targets at m_A'/m_chi1 = 2.5 and 3 with Delta = 0.1 m_chi1.

members.model_name: Simplified light FIMP with decay and scattering production
members.description: No documented public tool computes the freeze-in phase-space distribution including the 2-to-2 s- and t-channel scattering contribution with variable yield fraction Y_scat/Y_total; the paper's bespoke collision-term solver and its neural-network parameter maps exist only as undocumented arXiv ancillary files with no repository or tests (reproducibility_level: partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Package the collision-term integrator for decay-plus-scattering freeze-in (or extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in routines to output full momentum distributions rather than yields) together with the neural-network weights as a documented repository reproducing the A_3.5keV = 0.46 and N_sat = 63 benchmarks.

members.model_name: Self-interacting singlet scalar freeze-in/dark-freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No solver exists for the coupled freeze-in/dark-freeze-out history of this model: Higgs-decay freeze-in of the scalar, lambda_s-dependent internal thermalization, and relativistic 4-to-2 number-changing freeze-out, tracking both the relic abundance and the evolved momentum distribution f(p) needed downstream; existing freeze-in tools (e.g. micrOMEGAs) do not treat cannibal 4-to-2 dynamics or output phase-space distributions.
members.proposed_resolution: Develop (or extend a phase-space Boltzmann framework such as the unintegrated freeze-in codes used for FIMP spectra) a momentum-level solver for the s-sector with Higgs-decay source terms, elastic self-thermalization, and 4-to-2/2-to-4 collision terms including relativistic corrections, outputting Omega h^2, xi, and tabulated f(q) over the (lambda_hs, lambda_s, m_s) plane, validated against the paper's relic contours.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled gravitational scalar dark matter
members.description: No public mode-function/Bogoliubov code computes gravitational production of a spectator scalar with a non-minimal xi chi^2 R coupling through inflation and reheating, including the large-xi tachyonic/parametric-resonance regime that controls f(q) and the relic abundance in this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or extend a gravitational-particle-production mode solver (Bogoliubov evolution over a numerically evolved T-model inflaton background plus reheating equation of state) with the xi R term, outputting f(q), n_chi, and Omega_chi h^2 on a (m_chi, xi, H_end, T_reh) grid, validated against the paper's benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: Quantum-gravity-broken fermionic FIMP with domain walls
members.description: No solver exists for this model's freeze-in production combining UV scattering through dimension-five operators (reheating-sensitive) with IR production from s and h decays, including the resulting chi momentum distribution f(q); the paper works only at yield level, so the relic contours cannot be reproduced and no phase-space output exists for structure-formation use.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the unintegrated freeze-in Boltzmann equation for this model at the distribution-function level (extending existing FIMP phase-space frameworks in the style of the Konig-Merle-Totzauer sterile-neutrino codes, or micrOMEGAs freeze-in plus a dedicated f(q) integrator), covering both the T_RH-dominated UV contribution and the s/h decay IR contribution, validated against the paper's T_RH-Lambda_FI and v_s-m_DM relic contours.

members.model_name: keV sterile-neutrino double-seesaw freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public solver reproduces the scalar-decay freeze-in production of the 7.1 keV sterile neutrino with entropy dilution, i.e. the nonthermal f(p) with p/T = 2.477/d^(1/3) and the Omega_DM h^2 = 0.1199 benchmark; the calculation exists only in the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a scalar-decay freeze-in module (momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for in-equilibrium parent decay plus dilution factor, following the Merle-Totzauer formalism) that outputs f(p) and the relic abundance, validated against the paper's benchmark values.

members.model_name: Excited-bound-state t-channel superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No public code computes high-n bound-state formation, bound-to-bound electric/chromoelectric dipole transitions (n up to 1000), and the coupled mediator-yield Boltzmann network for the colored scalar t-channel mediator, so the excited-state relic depletion and its mediator-lifetime dependence cannot be reproduced or scanned outside the private implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the excited-bound-state rate calculation and network solver as a public package (e.g. extending DRAKE-style yield equations with the paper's Coulombic BSF/transition rate tables), validated against the paper's order-of-magnitude relic reduction and n_max convergence tests.

members.model_name: Inverse-seesaw sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter with dynamical lepton-number breaking
members.description: No public implementation exists of the freeze-in Boltzmann calculation for nu_4 production from thermalized pseudo-Dirac neutrino decays into the phi_1/phi_2/A/J scalar sector; the relic abundance currently rests on the paper's private semi-analytic solve.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the inverse-seesaw plus two-singlet-scalar Lagrangian and run it through micrOMEGAs' freeze-in machinery (or a dedicated decay-production Boltzmann script), validating against the paper's Omega h^2 ~ 0.12 benchmark scaling.

members.model_name: Light-vector freeze-in dark matter with plasmon decay
members.description: No public finite-temperature freeze-in integrator includes in-medium plasmon decay for light-vector/millicharged dark matter; existing freeze-in tools (micrOMEGAs) omit the plasma-mass channel that dominates sub-MeV production and do not output the momentum-resolved nonthermal f(p).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (or write a standalone integrator) with Braaten-Segel in-medium photon self-energies, resonant plasmon decay to chi pairs, and unintegrated collision terms so both the yield and the tabulated phase-space distribution f(p) are produced; validate against the paper's result that plasmon decay dominates sub-MeV production.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet multi-Higgs-inflation dark matter
members.description: No public pipeline connects the multi-field Higgs-inflation sector (nonminimal couplings xi_1, xi_2, stability/perturbativity at the unitarity scale, pseudo-scalar direction effects on n_s, r, and non-Gaussianity) to the low-energy inert-doublet quartics; micrOMEGAs handles only the low-energy freeze-out side of the route.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-doublet nonminimal-coupling potential in a multi-field inflation solver (e.g. PyTransport or MultiModeCode) to predict n_s, r, and f_NL, and couple it to two-loop RG running of the quartics (e.g. via SARAH-generated RGEs) down to the electroweak scale so inflationary stability regions map onto the micrOMEGAs input parameters.

members.model_name: Thermally produced gravitino LSP dark matter
members.description: No public, reusable BBN late-decay constraint tool covers hadronic plus electromagnetic cascades from NLSP decays in gravitino-LSP scenarios; existing public codes (e.g. ACROPOLIS) treat photodisintegration but not full hadronic showers, so the (NLSP abundance, tau, branching fractions) plane can only be checked against fixed literature grids rather than recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend ACROPOLIS (or wrap the published Kawasaki-Moroi-style hadronic-injection exclusion grids into an interpolated likelihood) to accept per-NLSP decay spectra from a spectrum calculator plus micrOMEGAs, outputting light-element constraints as a function of (NLSP identity, abundance, tau, branching fractions).

members.model_name: Degenerate leptophilic radiative-neutrino-mass dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model file exists for this radiative-neutrino-mass model with nearly degenerate N1/N2 and inert-doublet coannihilations; the paper's micrOMEGAs setup was private, so the relic-density colored regions cannot be reproduced or rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Ma-model Lagrangian (three N_i, inert doublet eta, Z2, complex Yukawa texture) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and rebuild the micrOMEGAs model file, validating against the paper's WMAP-era relic contours before updating to the Planck value.

members.model_name: Axionic mirage mediation axino dark matter
members.description: No solver exists for the coupled decay-chain yields (modulus abundance, gravitino branching, NLSP yield with possible annihilation, late entropy dilution) that set the axino relic abundance; the card's route lists a 'nonthermal momentum-distribution calculator' as a required but absent resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a coupled Boltzmann yield code for the modulus/gravitino/NLSP/axino chain parameterized by (modulus_yield, gravitino_branching, NLSP identity, tau_nlsp, f_PQ), including NLSP annihilation and entropy dilution, validated against the paper's O(100) MeV axino benchmark.

members.model_name: Strongly interacting hidden-sector pion cold dark matter
members.description: The relic density was computed with a privately modified micrOMEGAs; no public model implementation of the hidden-sector Gell-Mann-Levy pion sector with the two-Higgs-doublet portal (lambda_3, mixed h/H scalars) exists, so the freeze-out abundance and Higgs-portal direct-detection cross section cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the linear sigma-model hidden-pion Lagrangian with Higgs-portal mixing in FeynRules/CalcHEP and export to micrOMEGAs, validating against the paper's illustrative scan (tan beta = 1, quartics up to 4) for the relic-density contours.

members.model_name: Heavy-Z' effective complex-scalar NETDM
members.description: No implemented Boltzmann solve exists for UV freeze-in of complex scalar dark matter through the (f gamma_mu f)(chi partial^mu chi* - chi* partial^mu chi)/Lambda^2 contact operator with explicit reheating-temperature dependence; the route currently relies on the source paper's analytic scaling only.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar derivative-current operator in a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file and run it through the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module with reheating temperature T_RH as an input, or code the single-species yield ODE dY/dx with the analytic collision term directly, validating against the paper's Lambda/T_RH ~ 10^3-10^5 band.

members.model_name: Neutrino portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public momentum-level Boltzmann solver covers neutrino-portal freeze-in with both resonant (on-shell N decay) and non-resonant (off-shell N) production, so the nonthermal f(p) that both the relic density and the free-streaming constraint depend on cannot be recomputed outside the authors' private code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or obtain release of) an unintegrated Boltzmann solver for the L h -> N -> chi phi chain with resonant and 2-to-2 off-shell contributions, outputting tabulated f(q) in the CLASS ncdm psd-file format; extending micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module to momentum level is a natural host.

members.model_name: Inflaton-decay singlet-fermion dark matter with inflaton-mediated scatterings
members.description: No public phase-space Boltzmann solver exists for inflaton-decay dark matter with inflaton-mediated 2->2 collision terms, Pauli blocking, and back-reaction during reheating; the paper's custom solver is private, so the benchmark distributions (and any parameter scan beyond the TeV-scale examples) cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement and release the binned f(k,t) kinetic solver with the paper's collision terms, validated by reproducing the benchmark lambda_FSH values of 0.0734 Mpc (collisionless) and 0.0020 Mpc (with collisions) for the 10 keV, m_phi = 5 TeV, T_R = 1 TeV point, and optimize the collision integrals to enable a global parameter scan.

members.model_name: Gravitino NLSP decay to N-superpartner plus stable N
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for a late invisible two-body decay producing one massive (N-superpartner) plus one lighter stable (N) daughter with the full injected phase-space distribution; the card relies on analytic median-velocity estimates, blocking precision Delta N_eff, CMB, and linear transfer-function predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the CLASS decaying-CDM/dark-radiation module to two-body decays with massive daughters, evolving the daughter distribution function f(q, tau) from the delta-function injection at decay, parameterized by (parent mass, daughter masses, lifetime, initial abundance), and output Delta N_eff(z) and matter transfer functions.

members.model_name: Light Dirac neutrino portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the coupled Boltzmann equations for chi dark matter and right-handed-neutrino dark radiation across the three phi regimes (phi in equilibrium, superWIMP-like freeze-out-then-decay, and Higgs-portal freeze-in of phi), including the phase-space distribution f(p,T) needed downstream.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in MicrOMEGAs 5's freeze-in module for the yield calculation and release a companion unintegrated-Boltzmann solver for f(p,T) covering all three phi thermal histories, validated against the paper's benchmark Delta N_eff of order 1e-3 and its relic-density contours.

members.model_name: Vector-parent non-thermal vector WIMP dark radiation model
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation of the boosted two-body-decay dark-matter subcomponent: the decay-produced monochromatic-then-redshifting momentum distribution of B_mu from W_mu -> B_mu + photon (gamma set by M_X/M_DM and tau_X) is not available as a species in CLASS/CAMB, so the mixed cold-plus-boosted transfer function and the CMB response (Delta N_eff-like behavior) cannot be computed beyond the paper's analytic growth-suppression estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the decay-produced component as a non-cold dark matter species in CLASS (ncdm sector with a delta-function injection distribution at time tau_X, Lorentz factor M_X/2M_DM, and fraction f), validate against the paper's analytic Delta N_eff and growth-suppression formulas, and output mixed-DM transfer functions.

members.model_name: CKM-aligned heavy-quark freeze-in ALP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the full ALP phase-space distribution f(p) from freeze-in via flavor-violating heavy-quark decays q_i -> q_j a and quark-gluon/quark-antiquark scatterings including g_*(T) evolution and thermal QCD corrections near the heavy-quark thresholds; existing freeze-in tools return only integrated yields.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public freeze-in framework (e.g. the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module or an unintegrated-Boltzmann code) with the derivative ALP-quark operators and CKM-aligned charge matrices to evolve the momentum-dependent collision terms for decays and 2-to-2 scatterings, outputting Y_a and tabulated f(p) for downstream cosmology; validate against the paper's Omega h^2 band.

members.model_name: Single-flavor-transition heavy-quark freeze-in ALP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the full ALP phase-space distribution f(p) from freeze-in via a single flavor-violating heavy-quark transition (bs, bd, cu, sd, tu, or tc) through decays q_i -> q_j a and quark-gluon/quark-antiquark scatterings including g_*(T) evolution and thermal QCD corrections near the relevant quark threshold; existing freeze-in tools return only integrated yields.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public freeze-in framework (e.g. the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module or an unintegrated-Boltzmann code) with the derivative ALP-quark operator for one right-handed two-flavor transition at a time, evolving the momentum-dependent collision terms for decays and 2-to-2 scatterings and outputting Y_a and tabulated f(p) per transition benchmark; validate against the paper's Omega h^2 band.

members.model_name: Mirror matter dark matter with cooler mirror sector
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the exact mirror sector — a second photon-baryon plasma at temperature ratio x with mirror recombination, mirror Silk damping, and the associated Delta N_eff — so the processed power spectrum with its lambda_max peak, oscillations, and damping tail exists only as analytic scale estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an atomic-dark-matter/dark-photon CLASS implementation to exact mirror microphysics: duplicate the baryon-photon sector with rescaled temperature x, run a RECFAST-like mirror recombination, and validate against the paper's x < 0.2 CDM-like criterion and the lambda_max/lambda_S_prime ordering.

members.model_name: Light-vector freeze-in dark matter with plasmon decay
members.description: No released Boltzmann-solver configuration evolves this model's nonthermal sub-MeV freeze-in distribution together with millicharged DM-baryon drag; CLASS ncdm accepts tabulated f(p) and dmeff branches implement drag, but the combined implementation needed to reproduce the companion cosmology analysis does not exist publicly.
members.proposed_resolution: Modify CLASS to read the freeze-in f(p) from gap_1 as an ncdm species and merge the dmeff-style Coulomb-like DM-baryon momentum-exchange term, validating CMB spectra and matter power against the related sub-MeV freeze-in cosmology paper.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector glueball dark matter in a late-modulus low-reheat cosmology
members.description: The modulus reheating step uses an instantaneous-decay approximation with order-one corrections acknowledged by the paper; no numerical two-sector (visible plus hidden) reheating solver exists for this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small coupled Boltzmann solver evolving the modulus, visible radiation, and hidden radiation with a finite decay width and branching fraction B, replacing the instantaneous-decay temperatures used in the semi-analytic route.

members.model_name: Out-of-equilibrium U(1)_X hidden-sector dark-fermion model
members.description: No public two-temperature coupled Boltzmann solver exists for this U(1)_X hidden sector: the relic density and N_eff history require evolving visible and hidden temperatures plus yields of D, A_prime, S, and the pseudoscalar under feeble kinetic-mixing population, which the paper did with a private code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled visible/hidden-temperature Boltzmann system (collision terms for kinetic-mixing energy transfer plus dark-sector 2->2 reactions) as a public module, e.g. extending micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector/freeze-in machinery or releasing a standalone solver validated against the paper's benchmark points.

members.model_name: Fermionic UV freeze-in baryogenesis with early matter domination
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the dimension-6 UV freeze-in dark-matter yield together with the sector-wise lepton asymmetry in a background including an early matter-dominated era and its entropy injection; micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines cover neither the asymmetry source nor nonstandard EMD histories.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a reusable coupled Y_DM/Y_B-L Boltzmann module (or extend a leptogenesis code such as ULYSSES) with a decaying-matter component, taking T_RH, Lambda, lambda_i, and Delta_EMD as inputs, and validate against the paper's standard-history viability window.

members.model_name: Scalar UV freeze-in baryogenesis with early matter domination
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the dimension-5 UV freeze-in scalar dark-matter yield together with the sector-wise lepton asymmetry in a background including an early matter-dominated era and its entropy injection; micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines cover neither the asymmetry source nor nonstandard EMD histories.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a reusable coupled Y_DM/Y_B-L Boltzmann module (or extend a leptogenesis code such as ULYSSES) with a decaying-matter component, taking T_RH, Lambda, lambda_i, and Delta_EMD as inputs, and validate against the paper's standard-history viability window.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino freeze-in at stronger coupling
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the Boltzmann-suppressed freeze-in regime with reheating temperature below the sterile-neutrino mass, including the transition toward freeze-out at larger couplings; the relic calculation currently exists only as the paper's own equations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or implement a standalone solver of the paper's Boltzmann equations) to accept T_R < M with the scalar-bath abundance tracked, and validate against the paper's published relic curves in (M, lambda, T_R).

members.model_name: Dark glueballs with associated ultralight axion dark matter
members.description: No public dark-glueball relic calculator exists: the 3-to-2 number-changing freeze-out with cannibalistic self-heating, lattice-informed glueball spectra, and a hidden-to-visible temperature ratio T'/T is currently done by approximate semi-analytic estimates only.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Boltzmann code for 3-to-2 glueball freeze-out in a decoupled hidden sector, parameterized by (Lambda_dark, T'/T, gauge group), using lattice SU(N) glueball masses and dimensional 3-to-2 rates, and validate against the semi-analytic results in the glueball literature the card cites.

members.model_name: Non-Self-Conjugate ultra-light scalar dark matter with neutrino mediator
members.description: No likelihood exists for the UHE flux comparison: IceCube/Auger non-detections are published as source-flux limits, and there is no recast that folds detector effective areas with attenuated spectra so that propagation suppression can be distinguished from low source normalization.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast likelihood from public IceCube EHE effective areas and Auger exposures, computing expected event counts for MPR/Waxman-Bahcall benchmark fluxes attenuated by the model, for both the all-DM and ten-percent-DM scalar fractions.

members.model_name: Sub-keV fermionic dark matter with Fermi-pressure dwarf cores
members.description: No dwarf-spheroidal kinematic likelihood exists for quasi-degenerate fermionic cored profiles; the 70-400 eV core window rests on simplified halo-profile fits rather than a statistical comparison to stellar-kinematic data.
members.proposed_resolution: Embed the Thomas-Fermi degenerate-core plus thermal-envelope profile family in an existing Jeans-analysis framework (e.g. GravSphere-style dwarf kinematic fits) and build a likelihood over classical dwarf spheroidal velocity-dispersion data with anisotropy marginalization.

members.model_name: PAMELA-favored NMSSM neutralino with light pseudoscalar resonance
members.description: No cosmic-ray or gamma-ray likelihood exists for the PAMELA-favored benchmarks: the positron/antiproton comparison and the Fermi-LAT gamma tension are source-era plot-level statements (likelihood_available: no for both constraints), with no modern AMS-02/Fermi recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the a2-resonance annihilation to a1 h1 with mu-rich final states against AMS-02 positron-fraction and Fermi-LAT diffuse/dwarf likelihoods using a public propagation code and published likelihood tables, scanning halo-profile and boost-factor systematics.

members.model_name: Minimal scotogenic model with fermionic dark matter
members.description: No recast pipeline confronts the model's internal-bremsstrahlung gamma-ray signal (N1 N1 -> l l gamma via inert-scalar exchange, with the two-body channel p-wave suppressed) with indirect-detection data; the card lists the constraint with likelihood_available: no and the step was not run.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the internal-bremsstrahlung spectrum from the micrOMEGAs/MadDM model implementation over the (m_N1, m_eta, y) scan and feed it to the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood (and H.E.S.S. Galactic-center limits for multi-TeV masses).

members.model_name: Neutrino portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No ready Lyman-alpha likelihood accepts the nonthermal freeze-in momentum distribution directly; the card notes the thermal-WDM template can misestimate the bound, and the exact transfer-function-to-likelihood mapping was not reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the tabulated f(p) through CLASS ncdm to obtain T(k), then apply a shape-based Lyman-alpha recast (area criterion or the Murgia et al. alpha-beta-gamma parameterization with the MIKE/HIRES+XQ-100 likelihood) instead of the half-mode thermal-WDM mapping.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter in non-standard pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood exists that is valid for the sharply peaked, colder-than-thermal resonant sterile-neutrino spectra of this model; current practice maps to a thermal-equivalent WDM mass, an approximation the card flags as requiring validation for each non-thermal spectrum and DM fraction.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints directly on the CLASS-computed transfer functions of the resonant spectra, either via the area-criterion generalization of thermal-WDM bounds or by evaluating a flux-power emulator (e.g. trained on MP-Gadget/Sherwood-style grids) on the non-thermal T(k), including mixed cold+sterile fractions.

members.model_name: Non-resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter in non-standard pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: Lyman-alpha and structure limits are applied only through an approximate thermal-WDM equivalent-mass mapping that is not calibrated for the suppressed, cosmology-dependent momentum spectra produced in non-standard pre-BBN histories, and no numeric exclusion contour or likelihood is encoded.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f_s(p) into CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold ncdm species to obtain transfer functions, then recast published Lyman-alpha flux-power WDM constraints (area-criterion or emulator-based) into distribution-specific limits on the mass-mixing plane at each dark-matter fraction f_s.

members.model_name: Inflaton-decay singlet-fermion dark matter with inflaton-mediated scatterings
members.description: No Lyman-alpha or matter-power likelihood recast exists for this model's collision-cooled nonthermal distribution: the paper only compares a free-streaming-length proxy, and the card warns that a thermal-WDM mass mapping would be unreliable, so the allowed mass-coupling region has never been derived from an actual transfer-function-level constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the solver's tabulated f(p) into CLASS as a non-cold dark matter species to compute linear transfer functions, then constrain with a public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (e.g. an area-criterion or WDM-emulator comparison recalibrated on the actual transfer-function shape).

members.model_name: Gauge-singlet-Higgs decay sterile neutrino dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Recast mixed cold+hot dark matter Lyman-alpha constraints (e.g. the 1702.01764-style f_ncdm bounds or a Lyman-alpha flux emulator) onto the (f_eta, m_eta) plane using the model's transfer functions, replacing the one-percent rule of thumb with a proper likelihood.

members.model_name: Mixed collisionless dark matter free-streaming model

members.model_name: Conformal GUT hidden-sector inert dark fermion dark matter

members.model_name: Mixed collisionless dark matter free-streaming model

members.proposed_resolution: Extend AxiCLASS (or CLASS's scalar-field fluid module) to evolve three axion fluids with independent masses and fractions, each with a time-dependent equation-of-state switch at its depercolation redshift, and output the combined transfer function over the r_H/r_B threshold parameterization.

members.model_name: DFSZ freeze-in axino dark matter with bilinear R-parity violation
members.description: No public solver exists for the DFSZ freeze-in axino phase-space distribution: the channel-specific collision-term Boltzmann integration (2-body, 3-body, 2-to-2 with thermal masses) plus saxion entropy dilution is only implemented in the authors' private code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's reduced collision terms in a public momentum-dependent freeze-in code that outputs f(q) and yield per production channel for given (m_axino, T_R, mu, M_2, f_a) and applies the saxion dilution factor, in a format directly ingestible by CLASS ncdm.

members.model_name: Inflationary light dark photon dark matter
members.description: No linear perturbation/transfer-function solver handles a massive vector (dark photon) dark matter field with the paper's inflationary near-scale-invariant transverse-mode initial spectrum; existing fuzzy-DM implementations (axionCAMB-type CLASS/CAMB modifications) treat scalar ULDM with misalignment initial conditions only.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS/CAMB ultralight-DM module to evolve massive vector perturbations with the paper's I(phi)-produced mode spectrum as initial conditions, outputting the small-scale transfer suppression and an effective half-mode scale.

members.model_name: Sub-dominant axino decay gravitino dark matter
members.description: No transfer-function calculation exists for the mixed cold-gravitino plus relativistic decay-produced gravitino population: the card provides no phase-space distribution (distribution_function_available no) and the sub-3-percent warm-fraction bound is inherited from an approximate dark-radiation/warm-component estimate, not from a Boltzmann hierarchy for this two-population gravitino spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced gravitino momentum distribution f(q) from axino -> gravitino + axion (analytic for two-body decay of a frozen thermal axino population), combine it with the cold freeze-in gravitino component, and feed the tabulated mixed distribution to the CLASS ncdm module to compute the mixed cold+warm matter power spectrum as a function of Y_axino/Y_gravitino, m_axino, and tau_axino.

members.model_name: Two-cosine emergent dark-energy dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver evolves an ultralight scalar with a time-dependent effective mass that jumps at trapping (light axion-like phase to heavier trapped phase plus emergent dark energy) in the two-cosine potential; existing fixed-mass modules (axionCAMB, CLASS ULA/fluid implementations) do not cover the trapping transition.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the CLASS scalar-field/fluid module (or axionCAMB) with a background solver for the two-cosine potential and a perturbation sector whose effective sound speed and equation of state switch at z_tr, parameterized by (m, m0, f, c, n, z_tr), validated against the paper's z_tr~5 benchmark and the fixed-mass fuzzy-DM limit.

members.model_name: Non-adiabatically produced gravitational ultra-light scalar dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the gravitationally produced scalar's infrared-enhanced nonthermal distribution N_k(z = k/sqrt(2 m H_R)); the free-streaming suppression relative to CDM cannot be computed as a matter power spectrum without it.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's N_k as a tabulated psd file in CLASS's ncdm module (or an equivalent CAMB axion/ULDM branch for low-mass variants where wave effects matter), validate against the benchmark lambda_fs of about 70 pc, and release the input files.

members.model_name: Multifield ultralight dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/transfer-function code computes linear power spectra for general N-field ULA mixtures with arbitrary masses m_i and fractions f_i; existing ULA solvers handle one (or few) axion species and are benchmarked on the single-field case.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend axionCAMB or AxiCLASS to loop over N ULA species with independent (m_i, f_i), using the effective-fluid oscillation-averaged treatment per field, and verify the single-field transfer function is recovered at N=1.

members.model_name: nuMSM lepton-asymmetry resonant sterile-neutrino dark matter

members.model_name: Excited-bound-state t-channel superWIMP dark matter

members.model_name: Leptophilic light flavon hot-relic model

members.model_name: U(1)_B-L right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: The X-ray radiative-decay constraint is applied only as an order-of-magnitude mixing formula (theta_1^2 < ~1.7e-6 (1.6 keV/M_1)^5); no curated X-ray line-limit tables or likelihood are attached for a quantitative flux comparison across targets.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble published keV X-ray line limits (XMM-Newton, Chandra, NuSTAR, eROSITA blank-sky and dwarf/cluster targets) into digitized limit tables with matched J/D-factors and wire them into the width-to-flux step as an interpolable likelihood.

members.model_name: Multifield ultralight dark matter
members.description: The stellar-heating constraint exists only as an analytic scaling, not a released likelihood: no public pipeline maps N-field granularity spectra to stellar velocity-dispersion data in ultrafaint dwarfs with halo and stellar-population modeling.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast pipeline that takes multifield SP granularity power (from gap_1 simulations), computes diffusion-driven heating of stellar tracers in dwarf-galaxy potentials, and wraps it as a likelihood against measured velocity dispersions (e.g. Segue 1/2, Eridanus II style analyses), with N and m_i as parameters.

members.model_name: Resonant MSM sterile-neutrino dark matter with technically natural N2-N3 degeneracy
members.description: No packaged X-ray line likelihood exists to convert stacked XMM/Chandra/NuSTAR observations into a bound on the N1 mixing angle theta versus M_1 for this model; the card records the X-ray likelihood as unavailable and only literature exclusion curves are cited.
members.proposed_resolution: Package published X-ray line search results (blank-sky XMM/NuSTAR and dwarf/cluster stacks) into a reusable sin^2(2theta)-vs-M_1 likelihood module with explicit dark-matter-distribution systematics, applicable to any decaying keV dark-matter candidate.

members.model_name: Planck-scale axion fuzzy-lump dark matter
members.description: The SPARC rotation-curve extraction of (m_a_e, M_e, r_B_e) has no public machine-readable likelihood, covariance, or fitting pipeline for the condensate-plus-halo lump profile, so the benchmark cannot be reproduced or turned into a statistical constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a fitting pipeline combining the public SPARC baryonic mass models with a Schrodinger-Poisson soliton solver (e.g. PyUltraLight-derived profiles) plus the model's virialized halo component, and publish the resulting chi-square likelihood over (m_a_e, M_e, r_B_e) and baryonic nuisance parameters.

members.model_name: Sub-dominant axino decay gravitino dark matter
members.description: The overclosure/reheating and saxion constraints are hard analytic cuts and external requirements (likelihood_available no, saxion recasting_needed yes); no quantitative pipeline scans (m_axino, m_3/2, f_a, T_R) against modern relic-abundance, BBN, and N_eff data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's yield and lifetime formulas as a scan code with a joint likelihood over the Planck Omega_DM h^2 measurement, BBN late-decay bounds, and Planck N_eff, including a derived saxion abundance and decay history.

members.model_name: String-axiverse misalignment dark matter parameterization
members.description: No packaged pipeline connects the string-prior parameterization (M_susy, S, theta_i) through the uncorrelated axion isocurvature amplitude to a current Planck isocurvature likelihood; the paper's analysis used a quoted Planck 2015 bound rather than a reusable likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Configure CLASS with an uncorrelated CDM-isocurvature mode scaled to the axion fraction, couple it to the Planck 2018 likelihood in MontePython (the sampler already used by the paper), and expose the string-prior parameters as sampling parameters.

members.model_name: Light freeze-in dark matter from thermal two-body scalar decay
members.description: The unintegrated momentum distribution f(p) of chi from thermal two-body scalar decay is not derived; the paper only solves integrated number and energy Boltzmann equations, and the distribution depends on the unspecified spectrum (m_phi, m_psi), blocking any transfer-function computation.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for freeze-in from thermal two-body decay (a known semi-analytic calculation for decay-produced FIMPs) to obtain f(q) as a function of m_phi/m_chi and g_*_dec, and package it as a CLASS ncdm psd input table.

members.model_name: Inverse-seesaw sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter with dynamical lepton-number breaking
members.description: The Majoron Delta N_eff prediction lacks a coupled thermalization calculation: the paper itself notes a detailed simultaneous treatment of scalar/Majoron thermalization via lambda_1H is beyond its scope, leaving the CMB observable at order-of-magnitude level.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the coupled Boltzmann equations for the phi_1/phi_2/J sector thermalizing through the Higgs portal to obtain Delta N_eff(lambda_1H, v1, v2), then evaluate it against Planck N_eff posteriors with a CLASS-based Majoron cosmology run including late J -> nu nu decays.

members.model_name: Colored t-channel mediator freeze-in plus superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No implementation of the exact nonthermal dark matter momentum distribution combining the freeze-in component (from mediator decays and scatterings) and the late superWIMP decay component; the card records only an approximate phase-space treatment, and the Ly-alpha constraint currently relies on a thermal-WDM proxy.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the full phase-space distribution f(q) by integrating the unintegrated freeze-in and superWIMP decay Boltzmann equations (as done in tools like the FIMP module of micrOMEGAs or a dedicated code in the style of Ballesteros et al. freeze-in distribution calculations), then feed it to CLASS as a non-cold dark matter species to obtain the model-specific transfer function.

members.model_name: U(1)_B-L right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No momentum distribution f_N(p) has been derived for N_1 produced by thermal freeze-out followed by entropy dilution from heavy RHN decay (with possible Z_B-L-mediated interactions), so the free-streaming input to structure-formation constraints is undefined for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the redshifted post-dilution N_1 spectrum semi-analytically (thermal spectrum at freeze-out diluted by the computed S ~ 160 entropy factor), tabulate it, and feed it to CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold-dark-matter psd file to obtain the linear transfer function.

members.model_name: Leptophilic light flavon hot-relic model
members.description: The non-thermal momentum distribution of the freeze-in-produced eta is not derived (distribution_function_available: no), so the mixed hot+cold transfer function cannot be computed accurately for the freeze-in regime at large v_phi.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for freeze-in production through the charged-lepton couplings to obtain f_eta(q), and feed it into a Boltzmann solver's non-cold species (CLASS ncdm with a tabulated distribution) to get the subcomponent transfer function.

members.model_name: R-parity violating axino warm dark matter
members.description: The axino phase-space distribution f_axino(q) from thermal production after reheating (as a function of T_R, f_a, m_axino) is only approximate and never tabulated, yet it is the required input for the transfer-function step and for any warmness statement beyond a crude thermal-WDM analogy.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for axino production from thermal-bath scatterings (freeze-in/thermal-production treatment as in the related 1707.06418-style calculations) over the (T_R, f_a) benchmark region and release tabulated f(q) files consumable by CLASS ncdm.

members.model_name: DFSZ axino dark matter in the Kim-Nilles mechanism
members.description: The momentum-space phase-space distribution f(q) of freeze-in DFSZ axinos produced through the Kim-Nilles axino-Higgsino-Higgs (mu/f_a) and axino-top-stop (m_t/f_a) channels is not derived; without it neither the warmness of light axinos nor the transfer-function suppression can be computed for this specific channel mix.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent freeze-in Boltzmann equation for the two-body Higgs/Higgsino decay and stop-scattering collision terms (following the treatment used for freeze-in axino distributions in the related 1707.06418-style analyses), tabulate f(q) versus m_axino, f_a, mu, and the Higgs/Higgsino/stop spectrum, and feed it to the CLASS ncdm module to obtain the model-specific transfer function.

members.model_name: Two-cosine emergent dark-energy dark matter
members.description: Inhomogeneous trapping is not modeled: different patches of the universe can settle into different local minima of the two-cosine potential, producing domain walls and modified perturbations that the homogeneous background treatment cannot capture.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice scalar-field simulations of the two-cosine potential through the trapping epoch (adapting existing axion-string/domain-wall lattice codes) to quantify the fraction of Hubble patches trapped in adjacent minima and the resulting domain-wall energy density versus (c, n, z_tr).

members.model_name: Multifield ultralight dark matter
members.description: No public multifield Schroedinger-Poisson solver exists for N independent ultralight scalar fields with equal or different masses; the primary-paper simulation code is private, blocking reproduction of halo granularity and soliton structure for arbitrary (N, m_i).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public Schroedinger-Poisson code (e.g. PyUltraLight, AxioNyx, or a GAMER wave-DM branch) to evolve N coupled wavefunctions sourcing a common gravitational potential, and validate against the paper's N=1 limit and equal-mass granularity suppression.

members.model_name: LED instantly evaporating black-hole dark matter production
members.description: No public numerical code integrates LED black-hole formation from plasma collisions at reheating with higher-dimensional Hawking evaporation and dark-sector particle yield as functions of M_*, n, and T_RH, so the IEBH relic-abundance window cannot be recomputed or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a PBH evaporation code such as BlackHawk/FRISBHEE with n-extra-dimension Schwarzschild-Tangherlini thermodynamics and greybody factors plus a plasma-collision formation-rate module, and validate by recovering the 4D limit and the paper's quoted reheating-ratio window.

members.model_name: Modulated p=4 hilltop inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: No public inflationary perturbation-spectrum solver implements the modulated p=4 hilltop potential, so the numerical P_R(k) on CMB-to-PBH scales (beyond the slow-roll n_s expansion) cannot be reproduced or scanned; the paper's own numerical solution is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement V(phi) = hilltop p=4 plus periodic modulation in a public mode-equation solver (MultiModeCode or PyTransport, or as an external primordial-spectrum module for CLASS), parameterized by (Lambda^4, modulation period f, modulation amplitude), and validate against the paper's n_s(k_PBH)=4.91 and beta_s bounds.

members.model_name: Twin sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: The model-specific visible branching fraction Br(N_B -> SM photons + ...) as a function of the inter-sector mixing M_AB has not been computed, so the suppressed X-ray/gamma-ray line flux cannot be quantitatively recast against NuSTAR-style line limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the loop-induced N_B -> nu gamma (SM) radiative decay rate through the M_AB sterile-mixing portal in the seesaw limit, tabulate the visible branching over (M_NB, M_AB, mixing angles), and insert it into the standard sterile-neutrino line-flux formula against published line-search limit tables.

members.model_name: Dirac scotogenic freeze-in dark matter with gauged U(1) B-L
members.description: The FIMP phase-space distribution f(p) from off-shell B-L Z'-mediated gauge-scattering freeze-in under the low-reheating hierarchy (T_RH ~ 4 MeV - 5 GeV) has not been derived or implemented; the card records distribution_function_available: no, so warmness is judged only through a thermal-WDM proxy.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for f(p,T) with the SM-fermion annihilation collision term through the effective Z' operator and a T_RH cutoff (following existing FIMP distribution-function frameworks), then feed the tabulated f(p) into CLASS's ncdm sector to obtain the model's transfer function and thermal-equivalent WDM mass.

members.model_name: Phi_16 dark-thermal-bath degenerate fermion dark matter from broken U(1)_{B-L}
members.description: No tabulated phase-space distribution f(p) exists for Q_{B-L}=8 fermions produced by decay of the nonrelativistic phi_16 dark thermal bath; the paper provides only characteristic momenta and a free-streaming-length estimate, which is insufficient for a Boltzmann-solver transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced f(p) for a thermal-bath mother scalar decaying after becoming nonrelativistic (thermal parent spectrum convolved with two-body decay kinematics and redshifting), tabulate it, and feed it to the CLASS ncdm sector (psd_file) to compute T(k) and refine Delta N_eff.

members.model_name: Free phi_16 decay degenerate fermion dark matter from broken U(1)_{B-L}
members.description: No tabulated phase-space distribution f(p) exists for Q_{B-L}=8 fermions produced by decay of free, never-thermalized nonrelativistic phi_16 particles from inflaton decay; the paper provides only characteristic momenta and a free-streaming-length estimate, which is insufficient for a Boltzmann-solver transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced f(p) for the free-decay history (inflaton-decay phi_16 spectrum redshifted to nonrelativistic momenta, convolved with two-body decay kinematics), tabulate it, and feed it to the CLASS ncdm sector (psd_file) to compute T(k) and refine Delta N_eff.

members.model_name: Out-of-equilibrium U(1)_X hidden-sector dark-fermion model
members.description: The model-specific linear transfer function has never been derived: the dark-fermion-pseudoscalar/scalar momentum-transfer rate has not been mapped onto an ETHOS-type dark-matter-dark-radiation parameterization, so no P(k) exists for the late-kinetic-decoupling regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the angular-averaged momentum-transfer cross section for D scattering off the massless pseudoscalar bath, map it to ETHOS (a_n, alpha_l) coefficients including the T_h/T temperature ratio, and compute transfer functions in an ETHOS-modified CLASS.

members.model_name: High-scale darkogenesis with leptodark messenger sphaleron transfer
members.description: The Delta N_eff contribution of the massless z fermions is not computed; BBN safety is asserted only under a qualitative cooler-hidden-sector assumption with no hidden-to-visible temperature-ratio evolution.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the hidden-sector temperature ratio xi(T) from separate comoving entropy conservation after decoupling before the QCD transition, compute Delta N_eff at BBN and recombination, and compare with Planck/BBN Delta N_eff bounds.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter in non-standard pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No public resonant sterile-neutrino production solver supports a non-standard pre-BBN expansion history: existing quantum-kinetic/Boltzmann codes (e.g. sterile-dm for Shi-Fuller production) hard-code the standard H(T), so the model's central parameterization of a modified Hubble rate above T_tr cannot be scanned with existing tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Shi-Fuller solver (sterile-dm or an averaged-Boltzmann reimplementation) to take a parameterized H(T) with power-law index and transition temperature T_tr as inputs, tracking lepton-asymmetry depletion and entropy conservation, and validate against the paper's example cosmology wedges in the mass-mixing plane.

members.model_name: Twin sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public solver evolves the coupled SM and twin-sector baths with twin-sector Dodelson-Widrow sterile-neutrino production (including twin matter potentials), N_A freeze-out and out-of-equilibrium decay, and the resulting entropy injection and T_B/T_A history; the paper's calculation is in-house and unreleased.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (sterile-dm/DW-solver class) with a second gauge-sector bath: add twin matter potentials, coupled T_A(t)/T_B(t) evolution, and a decaying-N_A entropy-injection module, validated against the paper's Omega_NB = Omega_DM contours and pre-BBN injection timeline.

members.model_name: Non-resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter in non-standard pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No public sterile-neutrino production solver computes non-resonant freeze-in in non-standard pre-BBN expansion histories; existing Dodelson-Widrow codes (sterile-dm class) hard-code standard radiation domination and cannot scan H(T), T_tr, or entropy-producing low-reheating histories.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Dodelson-Widrow solver (or implement the paper's closed-form production kernels) with a parameterized pre-BBN module taking H(T), T_tr, and entropy injection as inputs, outputting f_s(p) and Omega_s h^2 over the (m_s, sin^2 2theta) plane for kination, scalar-tensor, and low-reheating cosmologies.

members.model_name: Gauge-singlet-Higgs decay sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the coupled singlet-Higgs thermal history plus sterile-neutrino production from S decays (in- and out-of-equilibrium regimes with entropy dilution); the calculation exists only as the paper's private analytic/numerical treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the S freeze-out and S -> NN decay kinetic equations in a public sterile-neutrino production framework (e.g. extend a sterile-DM production code of the sterile-nu/DW family or write a standalone momentum-grid Boltzmann integrator) parameterized by (m_S, lambda_HS, f, B), validated against the paper's B~0.01-0.1, f=(1-5)e-8 abundance examples.

members.model_name: keV sterile neutrino dark matter in a minimal extended seesaw A4 model
members.description: No end-to-end production pipeline connects the MES A4 model parameters (mass matrices, active-sterile mixing, lepton asymmetry) to a sterile-neutrino momentum distribution, relic density, and transfer function; the card names only a generic 'sterile-neutrino production solver' with no implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap an existing public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. sterile-dm for resonant/non-resonant oscillation production) with an interface that takes the MES A4 seesaw output (m_s, sin^2(2theta), lepton asymmetry) and returns f(p), Omega_s h^2, and a CLASS-ready momentum distribution.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with a neutrinophilic vector mediator
members.description: No public phase-space Boltzmann solver computes sterile-neutrino production with the neutrinophilic vector's modified neutrino self-interaction rates and thermal potential; existing sterile-neutrino production codes implement only Standard Model interaction rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm solver of Venumadhav et al.) with the paper's V_T(m_V, lambda, T) and Gamma(m_V, lambda, T) for a neutrino-only-coupled vector, solving df_4/dz on a momentum grid to output f_4(x,z) and Omega_4 h^2 over (m4, sin^2 2theta, m_V, lambda), validated against the paper's relic target curves.

members.model_name: Composite sterile Dirac neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No production solver covers this model's non-standard sterile-neutrino production histories: resonant production with a large lepton asymmetry at low reheating temperature and direct inflaton-decay production; existing public codes for resonant Shi-Fuller production assume a standard high-temperature radiation-dominated history.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public resonant-production code (e.g. sterile-dm) with a low-reheat background evolution and an inflaton-decay source term to output full momentum distributions f(p) over the (m_d, theta_d, lepton asymmetry, T_R) space.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with a gauged U(1) L_mu-L_tau vector
members.description: No public phase-space Boltzmann solver computes sterile-neutrino production with L_mu-L_tau vector-modified thermal potentials and muon/tau-flavor scattering rates; existing sterile-neutrino production codes implement only Standard Model interaction rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm solver of Venumadhav et al.) with the paper's flavor-dependent V_T(m_V, g_mu, T) and Gamma(m_V, g_mu, T), solving df_4/dz on a momentum grid to output f_4(x,z) and Omega_4 h^2 over (m4, sin^2 2theta, m_V, g_mu), validated against the paper's relic target curves.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public quantum-kinetic solver covers resonant active-sterile conversion with flavor-dependent lepton asymmetries, finite-temperature potentials, and damping across the full mass-mixing-asymmetry space; existing codes (sterile-dm-type) use simplified single-flavor or averaged-asymmetry treatments, as flagged by the card's common-active-asymmetry assumption.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-dm/LASAGNA-style quantum kinetic code to track per-flavor lepton asymmetries with modern finite-temperature potentials and damping rates, validated against the paper's cooler-than-NRP spectra and relic contours in (m_s, sin^2(2theta), L).

members.model_name: nuMSM lepton-asymmetry resonant sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public solver reproduces the paper's resonant (Shi-Fuller) sterile-neutrino production with quantum-field-theoretic finite-temperature rates in a lepton-asymmetric plasma, including asymmetry depletion, QCD-crossover rates, and general flavour patterns of the nuMSM asymmetry; the private numerical integration also assumes equal active asymmetries and below-equilibrium density.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the production code as a public module (extending existing resonant sterile-neutrino production solvers such as sterile-dm-class codes with the QFT rates and flavoured lepton asymmetries), with back-reaction included and output f(p) tabulated in the format CLASS/CAMB ncdm input expects.

members.model_name: Thermal-effects freeze-in sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public momentum-dependent Boltzmann code computes freeze-in production of keV sterile neutrinos from HNL, Higgs, and weak-boson decays with the paper's thermal self-energy corrections; existing sterile-neutrino tools implement oscillation (Dodelson-Widrow/Shi-Fuller) production only, and the paper itself used a coarse integration with the full scan left to future work.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's finite-temperature production rates Gamma_s(T,p) in a momentum-grid freeze-in solver (extending a framework like sterile-dm or a ULYSSES-style density-matrix code) to output f_DM and the full distribution function over the seesaw parameter space.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated self-interacting sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the sterile phase-space distribution f_s(p) and relic abundance for Dodelson-Widrow production modified by scalar-mediated sterile self-interactions (including resonant mediator and number-changing regimes); the primary paper's solver is private and public codes handle only the canonical non-interacting case.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. sterile-dm) with the phi-mediated nu_s nu_s collision terms and number-changing processes over the keV-GeV mediator scan, releasing f_s(p) and Omega_s h^2 as functions of (m_s, theta, y, m_phi), validated against the paper's production-regime benchmarks.

members.model_name: Low-reheating visible sterile-neutrino hot dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No public quantum-kinetic/Boltzmann solver computes active-sterile oscillation production in a low-reheating cosmology (T_R ~ 5 MeV); existing sterile-neutrino production codes assume a standard high-temperature thermal history, leaving only the paper's approximate f_s(E,T) scaling formula.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino kinetic code (e.g. a sterile-dm or LASAGNA-type solver) to start integration at a specified reheating temperature with matter effects and flavor structure, parameterized by (m_s, sin^2 2theta, T_R, active flavor, lepton asymmetry), and validate against the paper's Omega_s h^2 ~ sin^2 2theta m_s T_R^3 scaling.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with scalar-mediated neutrino NSI
members.description: No public Boltzmann/quantum-kinetic solver computes sterile-neutrino production including complex-scalar-mediator-induced neutrino interaction rates and thermal potentials together with parameterized nonstandard pre-BBN expansion histories H(T); the paper's solver is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm quantum-kinetic solver) to add scalar-mediator collision rates and finite-temperature potentials (m_phi, lambda_phi) and a user-supplied H(T), outputting Omega_s and f_s(p) on the paper's 10 GeV to 0.1 MeV integration range; validate against the paper's over/underproduction boundaries.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with neutrinophilic vector NSI
members.description: No public Boltzmann/quantum-kinetic solver computes sterile-neutrino production including neutrinophilic U(1)_np vector-mediator-induced neutrino interaction rates and thermal potentials together with parameterized nonstandard pre-BBN expansion histories H(T); the paper's solver is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm quantum-kinetic solver) to add neutrinophilic-vector collision rates and finite-temperature potentials and a user-supplied H(T), outputting Omega_s and f_s(p) on the paper's 10 GeV to 0.1 MeV integration range; validate against the paper's over/underproduction boundaries.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from matter-antimatter separation at the QCD phase transition
members.description: No sterile-neutrino production integrator handles active-to-sterile conversion in a spatially inhomogeneous plasma with domain-crossing resonances; public resonant-production codes (sterile-dm class solvers for homogeneous Shi-Fuller production) cannot represent per-crossing conversion probabilities in matter-antimatter domains.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a homogeneous resonant sterile-neutrino production code with a domain-ensemble layer: sample neutrino trajectories through domains with the simulated size distribution, apply Landau-Zener crossing probabilities per resonance, and integrate to Omega_N and f_N(p) over the transition duration.

members.model_name: Minimal left-right symmetric keV right-handed neutrino dark matter
members.description: No packaged pipeline exists that maps the MLRSM parameters (v_R, M_W_R, M2, M3, theta, Y_Delta_ee) to the 0nubb amplitude with propagated nuclear-matrix-element uncertainties and to LHC dilepton/heavy-neutrino exclusions; both recasts are currently done point-by-point in the literature.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module combining published MLRSM 0nubb master formulas with tabulated NME sets (propagating their spread as a nuisance) and the ATLAS/CMS W_R->lN dilepton limits, exposing a joint likelihood over the card's input parameters.

members.model_name: Colored t-channel mediator freeze-in plus superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No implemented collider recast pipeline for the long-lived colored mediator: R-hadron and displaced-top limits are taken from published stop/R-hadron recasts with no detector simulation run and no likelihood available for this model's lifetime-mass plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in an LLP recast framework such as SModelS (LLP module) or MadAnalysis5/CheckMATE with lifetime reweighting, validating against the published 1250 GeV detector-stable R-hadron limit and adding displaced-top signal regions for intermediate lifetimes.

members.model_name: Next-to-minimal supergravity-motivated neutralino dark matter
members.description: No implemented LHC recast covers the NmSuGra collider-reach observable: existing simplified-model recast databases (SModelS/CheckMATE) are MSSM-oriented and only partially cover NMSSM spectra with singlino admixture, and no recast for these benchmarks is identified on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Pass NMSSMTools spectra through SModelS for simplified-model coverage and supplement singlino-enriched cascade topologies with dedicated CheckMATE/MadAnalysis recasts of Run-2 electroweakino and squark/gluino searches.

members.model_name: Thermal-effects freeze-in sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: Production above the electroweak crossover via 2-to-2 scatterings is not computed (the paper's thermal decay-rate treatment applies only below T_SSB about 160 GeV), leaving the high-temperature contribution to the abundance and spectrum of heavy-HNL scenarios undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the symmetric-phase 2-to-2 and 1-to-2 production rates (following established thermal leptogenesis/HNL rate calculations at T > T_SSB) and add them to the same freeze-in solver so the abundance is complete across the crossover.

members.model_name: PAMELA-favored NMSSM neutralino with light pseudoscalar resonance
members.description: The nonthermal relic density is only sketched: the late-decaying gravitino/modulus cosmology that must set Omega_DM for a 135-301 pb annihilation cross section is not quantitatively specified or computed anywhere in the route.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify the decaying-field mass, abundance, and decay temperature, and solve the standard post-decay Boltzmann equation (annihilation-dominated regime) to verify that the observed relic density and the required present-day <sigma v> are simultaneously attainable for the benchmark points.

members.model_name: Minimal scotogenic model with fermionic dark matter
members.description: The loop-induced inelastic N1-nucleus scattering that can arise for nearly degenerate N1,N2 with complex Yukawas is flagged in the card but not derived, so the direct-detection channel cannot be evaluated in that corner of parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the one-loop (photon/Z-penguin and box) N1-quark effective operators including the N1-N2 splitting, and implement them in micrOMEGAs' direct-detection module to recast XENON/LZ inelastic limits versus the N1-N2 mass splitting.

members.model_name: Saxion-decay axino warm dark matter with axion dark radiation
members.description: The small-scale cutoff of decay-produced axinos is only estimated via an approximate free-streaming-length mapping to a 1-4 keV thermal WDM mass; no exact linear transfer function has been computed from the actual nonthermal two-body-decay momentum distribution for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced axino phase-space distribution f(q) (two-body saxion decay with lifetime tau_s), feed it to the CLASS ncdm module as a tabulated distribution, and compute the exact transfer function and half-mode mass across the m_s, tau_s, m_axino/m_s parameter space.

members.model_name: Two-cosine emergent dark-energy dark matter
members.description: The mapping between pre-trapping and post-trapping dark-matter perturbations needed to translate CMB-era axion isocurvature constraints to present-day parameters is not derived; standard axion isocurvature bounds assume the field observed today is the field at recombination.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the isocurvature transfer through the trapping transition (how delta-phi fluctuations map onto the trapped heavy component) as a function of z_tr, then recast Planck isocurvature amplitude limits in the (H_inf, f, theta_i, z_tr) plane.

members.model_name: SO(10) GUT inflation model with axion dark matter

members.model_name: Exothermic Yukawa-potential interacting dark matter
members.description: No structure-formation simulations exist for exothermic self-interacting dark matter in this model's regime: N-body runs implementing velocity kicks from down-scattering are needed to predict low-mass-halo evaporation, core formation, and the subhalo mass function, which the card can only describe qualitatively.

members.model_name: U(1) late-decaying dark matter
members.description: No public simulation-calibrated mapping exists from (epsilon, tau_chi_star) to dwarf-cusp softening and subhalo disruption for this model's regime: the cited external simulations cover selected windows (epsilon ~ 5e-5 to 7e-5, tau ~ 1-30 Gyr) and the card's benchmark epsilon ~ 1e-5 lies in an uncalibrated small-kick regime, with baryonic feedback degeneracies unquantified.

members.model_name: nuMSM lepton-asymmetry resonant sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear structure predictions (halo and subhalo mass functions) are uncalibrated for the strongly non-Fermi-Dirac resonant spectra; the paper explicitly states that simulations with the non-equilibrium spectra are still needed, so dwarf-halo and satellite-count comparisons rely on approximate thermal mappings.

members.model_name: Non-adiabatically produced gravitational ultra-light scalar dark matter
members.description: The PPTA local-density bound on coherent ultralight-scalar potential oscillations is only partially available as a likelihood; no public timing-residual likelihood is packaged for evaluating this model's low-mass variants in the nanohertz band.

members.model_name: Colored t-channel mediator freeze-in plus superWIMP dark matter

members.model_name: Axionic mirage mediation axino dark matter
members.description: No BBN likelihood exists for the model's late injections: the visible energy spectra and branching fractions of modulus, gravitino, and NLSP decays are not derived, so the tau_NLSP < 1 s benchmark safety statement cannot be promoted to a quantitative constraint.

members.model_name: Modulated p=4 hilltop inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: No pipeline maps this model's computed P_R(k) to a PBH abundance beta and mass function: the card records only an order-of-magnitude P_R ~ 1e-3 formation threshold, with no collapse-threshold prescription, window-function choice, or extended-mass-function treatment.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated self-interacting sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No forward model exists for DSNB spectral dips from scalar-mediated sterile self-interactions: the related-paper dip calculation must be re-derived for the scalar mediator's cross section and combined with a DSNB flux model and future-detector response, none of which are packaged.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar-mediated nu-nu_s scattering optical depth over the relic sterile background, convolve with a standard DSNB flux model, and fold in Hyper-Kamiokande/JUNO sensitivity forecasts, validating against the related vector-case benchmark before recasting.

members.model_name: N-superpartner NLSP decay to stable N plus light gravitino
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for this model's late invisible NLSP decay into two dark-sector daughters (light gravitino plus stable ~GeV singlet N), needed to compute Delta N_eff and the daughter phase-space distributions beyond the paper's median-velocity estimate; the card lists a 'Boltzmann solver for decaying dark matter/dark radiation' as a required but absent code resource.

members.model_name: Scalar-parent non-thermal vector WIMP dark radiation model
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the sharply boosted, decay-produced vector dark-matter subcomponent (delta-function-like f(p) at gamma ~ M_X/2M_DM, injected at tau_X); the matter-power suppression is estimated only analytically, so the f < 0.01 WMAP9/Lyman-alpha bound cannot be recomputed or updated with current data.

members.model_name: Bino-to-gravitino non-thermal dark radiation model
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the sharply boosted, decay-produced gravitino subcomponent (delta-function-like f(p) at gamma ~ M_B/2M_G, redshifting after tau_B); the matter-power suppression is currently estimated only analytically, so the f < 0.01 WMAP9/Lyman-alpha bound cannot be recomputed or updated with current data.

members.model_name: Axionic mirage mediation axino dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann/transfer-function calculation exists for decay-produced axinos with this model's nonthermal momentum spectrum; only an effective free-streaming-scale proxy is available, which the card flags as insufficient for precision Lyman-alpha recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the decay-produced axino phase-space distribution f(q) from the NLSP decay kinematics and feed it to CLASS as a tabulated non-cold-dark-matter (ncdm) species to obtain the model transfer function, replacing the order-of-magnitude lambda_FS estimate.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled gravitational scalar dark matter
members.description: For xi above roughly 70 the analysis stops because backreaction and inflaton-condensate fragmentation during resonant production are not captured by the linear mode-function treatment, leaving the large-xi parameter space unevaluated.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from matter-antimatter separation at the QCD phase transition

members.model_name: Extreme axion dark matter with cosine potential fluid modeling
